Exchanges.Text:
Good morning, Gate team-c.

Our sprint goal is: Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically, and there are 6 days left in the sprint.

Daniel, quick check: is story 3 done, is story 4 done, and is task 15 done?
What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: yesterday you finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two, today you’re adding idempotency keys, and nothing is blocking you.

Daniel, story 3, Customer payment plan summary page, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.
Who can help unblock this dependency on the idempotency keys so you can pick the summary page back up?
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.
Thanks, Daniel. Handing the floor back.

Thanks, Daniel.
Maya, is story 5 done and is bug 12 done, and what did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let's take that offline; I'll add it to the parking lot, and Maya, please carry on.
That's everything from me.
Maya, for bug 12 and the access to the platform team’s staging gateway, who can help unblock this?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll pair with him on staging access today.

Maya, story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.
Maya, I’ve noted the blocker that the PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review, and your commitment to chase it today, and this blocker will be flagged for follow-up.

Thanks, Maya.

Admin, yesterday you said “I should finish it tomorrow” about task 14— is it done? What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.

Admin, I’ve noted you finished the refund API tests, are working on the payment retry story today, and have no blockers.

task 14, Write retry load test, is past its due date. What is the new date?
It slept because the sandbox was down.
I should finish it tomorrow.
Admin, for the blocker that the sandbox was down and task 14 slipped, who can help unblock this?
Maya can help.
She's already chasing the platform team about the sandbox, so I'll sync with her after the stand-up.

We heard blockers around bug 12 with sandbox gateway timeouts and access to the platform team’s staging gateway, PCI scan exceptions waiting on security review, and work slipping when the sandbox was down; Daniel’s summary page is on track and will resume once idempotency keys are in. One side discussion about gateway timeouts was parked for offline follow-up. Items not covered were task 19 and task 15, and their owners will get a follow-up. Follow-ups, including for anyone absent or who didn’t respond, are coming in Teams—thank you, everyone.
